items.html: And we return to the matter: when the feet of Atik entered within the Rosh of AA, certainly at first all the seven lower [Sefirot] shone there, in his Rosh, only an illumination; however, his main clothing is only in the whole Partzuf of AA, as above. And we shall explain this first illumination in the Rosh of AA, how it was. And the matter is as was said, that there are seven corrections in the Rosh of AA, and within these seven corrections Atik first spread in his seven lower [Sefirot]. However, his main clothing in the Rosh of AA is only in the two first corrections, for they are complete Sefirot of AA, and they are its Keter and Hochma; but the rest of the five corrections are only an illumination, as above. And understand this.
